meals.blurb: The first night. Off the plane, onto a train, into an Uber, dropped the bags, and walked twelve minutes to a fish restaurant on the Bjørvika waterfront. This is where the trip actually starts.
Eaten fast, with one eye on the clock — the Bergen train left Oslo S at 08:25 and does not negotiate.
Luggage in the cabin, then dinner in the ship's restaurant while Bergen slid away behind. The voyage was full board — every meal for two days came off that galley.
The last meal on the ship, eaten while it came up the fjord into Trondheim. Ashore at 09:45.
On the Oslo day-two list, in the cellar of an old monastery. Whether they went is not written down anywhere — she will know.
